render_measurement.sample: 1 synthetic Chinese dispatch-note line, real repository template and resource-limited child renderer, default one slot isolated in a private TMPDIR; n=1
render_measurement.interpretation: Shared host; immediately afterward /proc/loadavg reported one-minute load 28.73 and getconf reported 6 online logical CPUs. Single observation, not an SLA, regression comparison or production measurement. Benchmark excludes request handling, fetching business data, queuing and user-perceived print completion. WeasyPrint logged unsupported ::note-call / ::note-marker / ::note-callback selectors during setup; visual fidelity of each field was not checked.

current_code_findings.subject: CI coverage
current_code_findings.acceptance: Fresh CI run combines exactly the two required named artifacts, fails if either is missing and uses the policy checker for overall >=72.38%, relocation >=80%, replenishment >=80%. Preserve a negative fixture for each file threshold.

current_code_findings.subject: Snapshot consistency and private evidence
current_code_findings.finding: Snapshot hooks run before writer quiescence. Their implementation is external. Private arrival/return mounts are prepared in the image but are omitted by the volume preflight; inclusion in the external backup was not established.
current_code_findings.acceptance: Match snapshots at a common recovery point (or quiesce every writer first); restore isolated test copies including attachments in both private volumes, verify document correspondence/checksums, reconciliation, and RPO <=24h / RTO <=1h. Wrong permissions on either private mount must fail preflight.

current_code_findings.subject: Scheduler health
current_code_findings.finding: The deployment covers web DB readiness and a fresh Boss worker heartbeat. Billing scheduler verification checks running state and image. Its loop may continue after a logical failure; billing job records and a failed-job dashboard exist. No inference about external monitoring installations.
current_code_findings.acceptance: Simulate a due-but-uncompleted billing job with scheduler process alive; signal overdue/failed scoped jobs within the agreed accounting cutoff and clear alert after successful reconciliation. On non-due days no false alarms.

current_code_findings.subject: Production-like capacity and external release signoff
current_code_findings.finding: Named historical register marks ten external checks NOT_RUN. Search of JSON/Markdown under var/assessments, var/system-tests and docs/reports before creating this report did not identify external records containing current short/full commit; other systems were not inspected.
current_code_findings.acceptance: Run same-warehouse hotspot and cross-warehouse acceptance on pinned candidate with specified mix: 50 users 30 min and 100 users 5 min after warmup; read/write p95 <=800/1500 ms, unexpected failures/timeouts <1%, zero inventory/finance discrepancies. Sign device, real payment, recovery and 196 manual cases with scoped evidence. Test normal and largest legal PDF under actual container limits and measure interference and busy rate.
